messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Borealis wants to move the POC to exec review this week. Need final Order Form + countersign path. Main blockers: 1) customer requests Net-60 2) KMS/HSM appendix (they want BYOK) 3) DPA asked for subprocessor list v3
steve_legal: Thanks. Please push the latest MSA/DPA redlines we sent last quarter. I'll re-open section 7.4 and the audit clause if they insist on BYOK. Do we have their preferred SOW language?
anika_finance: Net-60 is doable but requires procurement PO before we invoice. If they sign Net-60 we need treasury sign-off on credit. Who owns credit check?
maria_sales: Borealis procurement said they'll issue PO within 48h if we accept Net-60 on the POC invoice. They're hung up on the KMS appendix — they want a reference to their HSM provider and an attest of key isolation.
ella_se: For BYOK we can offer customer-managed keys via our KMS connector. There's a one-time onboarding task and an HSM quote. I attached steps earlier. Do we need a technical addendum in the Order Form?
steve_legal: Yes addendum is simplest. I'll add a short KMS appendix: responsibilities, key control, and no-authorized-access covenant. Also: they redlined the Subprocessors list to include 'EdgePartnerX' and want contract with that subproc — we should confirm privacy language.
sam_security: From security: need SIG-Lite + SOC2 attestation. EdgePartnerX requires a security questionnaire result. If they insist, we'll need security review and likely an addendum around subprocessors. That will add ~3 business days.
maria_sales: Customer asked for DocuSign but their legal requires two countersignatures (procurement + IT). They asked if we can do synchronous signing to avoid manual routing. Any automation options?
anika_finance: We can allow dual signer envelopes, but finance needs the PO number embedded on the first page. Also wiring instructions only after PO + countersign.
steve_legal: Routing: propose primary sign route: Borealis (procurement) -> Borealis IT (security) -> Redwood legal. If they sign first, Redwood countersign via Adobe Sign. If DocuSign preferred on their side, we can accept but need the envelope chain preserved.
ella_se: Technical note: enabling BYOK with their HSM will temporarily block streaming telemetry to hosted logs until key binding is validated. This may impact some POC metrics — we should document.
maria_sales: Can we get a quick tradeoff doc for the customer: BYOK impact on metrics + onboarding time + cost? If we share that with procurement they may accept Net-60.
sam_security: I'll prepare a one-pager outlining impacts + mitigations (data not persisted, audit hooks, expected 1–2 day verification window).
steve_legal: I'm uploading an order form draft with the KMS appendix and the subprocessor clause we discussed. maria_sales, can you confirm the billing contact and their PO flow so I can include the PO clause?
maria_sales: Billing contact is finance@borealis.com and procurement contact is jen.proc@borealis.com. They requested an invoice to include 'PO#' and 'Project: Borealis-POC-2026'.
anika_finance: Confirmed. Once PO is in, we accept Net-60 for the POC only. Any ongoing commitment must be Net-30 standard.
procure-bot: Automated reminder: Attach signed DPA and PO to billing ticket #BR-4821 to trigger invoicing.
maria_sales: Quick ask — can legal accelerate review if we mark this as 'POC pilot: priority'? Steve?
steve_legal: I'll prioritize and aim for same-day redline turnaround. If security needs to add the subprocess review, it'll push to tomorrow EOD.
ella_se: I'll draft the BYOK appendix and list the exact onboarding steps (API keys, HSM vendor name, ephemeral certs).
sam_security: Uploading SIG-Lite snapshot now. If they can sign the SIG-Lite + DPA, we can waive the separate subproc contract temporarily under an LOE clause.
maria_sales: Perfect. I'll push the order form + draft KMS appendix to Jen and request PO issuance. Will ping here once they ACK. :thumbsup:
steve_legal: Thanks — ping me if they make any unusual redlines. If they try to remove our limitation of liability cap we won't approve.
maria_sales: Understood. Will escalate to execs if they push on liability.
procure-bot: Reminder: If Net-60 accepted, set invoice terms flag to 'special-net60' and tag account manager.
